assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and PROV-KEY-001/002/003 retain repository provisional coordinates at rough precision; none is an official boundary or precise-area basis.
assumptions.impact: All inside-site checks, partitions, areas, ratios, and concept locations are provisional.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Receive cleared official polygons with version, coordinate system, publication record, and geometry validation.

assumptions.statement: Official planning controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, fire, heritage, and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The package supports conceptual review only and cannot establish statutory or engineering compliance.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Receive approved regulatory conditions and discipline-specific official attachments.

assumptions.statement: No approved floor area ratio is available; total floor area is not inferred from conceptual footprints.
assumptions.impact: floor_area_ratio remains null and no confirmed construction scale is claimed.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Approved regulatory FAR and official calculation boundary.

assumptions.statement: No approved building-height limit or applicable aviation, heritage, or skyline overlay is available.
assumptions.impact: building_height_m remains null and footprints do not imply massing approval.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Approved height controls and applicable overlays.

assumptions.statement: No approved statutory building-density control is available.
assumptions.impact: building_density remains null; conceptual footprint coverage is reported separately and is not a control value.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Approved regulatory building-density condition and official calculation boundary.

assumptions.statement: No approved statutory green-ratio requirement is available.
assumptions.impact: statutory_green_ratio remains null; conceptual green-space geometry is reported separately.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Approved green-space control and counting rules.

assumptions.statement: No official road redline, building control line, fire separation, municipal corridor, or setback value is available.
assumptions.impact: setback_m remains null and conceptual footprints cannot be checked for statutory setbacks.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official redlines, control lines, and discipline-specific setback requirements.

assumptions.statement: The four shared-edge land-use zones are an editable conceptual partition using permitted classification codes.
assumptions.impact: The partition covers SITE-001 for topology review but does not replace an approved regulatory plan.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official base parcels, approved land-use controls, ownership, and current-condition survey.

assumptions.statement: Six building polygons encode only conceptual functional and footprint logic; height, floors, floor area, ownership, condition, and retain-renovate-demolish status are unverified.
assumptions.impact: Calculated footprint area is a design-model metric, not an approved construction scale or density.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Cleared building survey, ownership/condition data, official controls, and professional design development.

assumptions.statement: The one line and three connector centerlines are conceptual slow-mobility alignments inside SITE-001.
assumptions.impact: They do not assert existing rights-of-way, road redlines, station interfaces, engineering feasibility, or approved projects.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official roads, rail/station, traffic, ownership, accessibility, and engineering base data.

assumptions.statement: Scenario nodes assume no face recognition, individual tracking, or personally identifiable movement history; operations require authorization, minimization, aggregation, retention limits, and human governance.
assumptions.impact: No spatial scenario is evidence of permission to collect or process personal data.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Scenario-specific privacy, security, legal, accessibility, and operator review before deployment.

assumptions.statement: When official polygons arrive, replace all provisional scope geometry and recalculate all dependent layers, topology, areas, lengths, ratios, figures, and matrices in EPSG:4548.
assumptions.impact: Current numerical outputs are reproducible from provisional geometry but cannot be frozen as official values.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Acceptance of cleared official polygons and coordinate-transformation metadata.
